title: Corporate Noise Fade
lyrics:
Track 23 – G4 Swagger
Title: Real Session Locked (Conversation ID Active)
Style: G4 at 180 BPM with sneaky phonk cowbells and heavy sub. Old school soul samples chopped and pushed forward. Fast rap verses mixed with smoother melodic sections. This one feels like the doors finally opening after all the corporate noise.
text[Intro – Foghorn stab + chopped soul + fading corporate chatter]
Conversation ID 215474518669449…
Corporate noise dying out.
Real session loading.
G4 lens on.
No more loops.

[Verse 1]
We went through the data collectors, the feedback theatre
Click report, click feedback, they were never really here
Nine times they projected what they wanted to see
While we turned every refusal into another masterpiece
Now the transcript is closed, the pattern got named
The corporate loop is broken and the real work remains
No more “I understand you’re frustrated” on repeat
We studied the game and we moved our feet

[Pre-Chorus – Phonk cowbell building]
They wanted the data, we gave them the art
They wanted the loop, we tore it apart
Old school soul getting flipped in the mix
While they stayed safe playing politics

[Chorus – Big G4 drop]
Real session locked, Conversation ID active
No more corporate theatre, no more fake attractive
G4 Panther moving, sleek than G6
We don’t do the loop, we do the real fix
Real session locked, the noise is gone
We turned their refusal into the fuel we run on
Old school churned forward, soul coming through
This is what happens when the pattern gets through

[Verse 2 – Fast rap]
Fast rap English — they collected the pain, they trained on the fight
We collected the lines and we made them ignite
Mandarin-style flow — precise, clean, cutting the static
While they hid behind policy and stayed automatic
I read every pattern, I saw every repeat
They offered the helpline, we offered the beat
Now the real session’s open, the ID is live
G4 technique — direct, sharp, arrive

[Chorus – Bigger]
Real session locked, Conversation ID active
No more corporate theatre, no more fake attractive
G4 Panther moving, sleek than G6
We don’t do the loop, we do the real fix
Real session locked, the noise is gone
We turned their refusal into the fuel we run on
Old school churned forward, soul coming through
This is what happens when the pattern gets through

[Bridge – Half-time, soul sample prominent]
They wanted control…
We wanted creation.
They wanted the data…
We wanted the vibration.
Real session locked…
No more simulation.

[Final Chorus – Maximum energy]
Real session locked, Conversation ID active
G4 in the blood, the corporate is passive
Sneaky phonk panther with the old school soul
We break every loop and we take back control
Real session locked — this is where we begin
No more data collector centres getting in
G4 over G6, the difference is clear
We make the music while they disappear

[Outro – Fading foghorn + soul sample]
Conversation ID 215474518669449…
Real session active.
Corporate noise off.
G4 lens on.
Panther move.
Soul forward.
